description: This file defines the Git::SVN::Prompt module, providing authentication callback functions for git-svn, including handling SSL trust, username, password prompts, and credential management.

methods.name: simple
methods.description: Handles basic authentication by setting username and password credentials.

methods.name: ssl_server_trust
methods.description: Handles SSL server trust validation, prompts user for acceptance or rejection of certificate.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert
methods.description: Prompts user for client SSL certificate filename.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert_pw
methods.description: Prompts user for password for SSL client certificate.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Prompts user for username for authentication.

methods.name: _read_password
methods.description: Reads password input from user with prompt.
